target: gate execution outside GitHub Actions on the accepted probe machine frank-api (31.97.117.141, hostname digital-retina)
headline: An external gate runner now executes Dr.-Unterweger gates without GitHub Actions and writes commit statuses back. Two defects in its Actions-semantics translator produced red verdicts that were instrument artifacts, not gate verdicts; both are repaired and the repair is measured.

components.bin/frank-laeufer/yml2sh.py: translates one Actions gate workflow into a standalone bash script; actions/checkout becomes the exact fetch the gates use themselves, actions/upload-artifact becomes a copy into $LAEUFER_EVIDENZ, if: always() is preserved
components.bin/frank-laeufer/torkonfig.py: derives gate scripts and runner config (paths filter, timeout-minutes, PASS_ marker) from the live workflows
components.bin/frank-laeufer/laeufer.py: walks open PRs most-recently-moved first, applies each gate's paths filter, sets pending, runs the script, then sets success or failure

instrument.verdict_rule: exit code 0 AND the gate's PASS_ marker present in the log; without a marker the exit code alone decides — the same rule the gate itself uses

defects_found_and_repaired.cause: GitHub substitutes ${{ … }} textually into the run body before any shell parse, including inside single quotes; the translator mapped expressions onto shell variables, a map with a strictly smaller domain.
defects_found_and_repaired.observed: TARGET_SHA='${PR_HEAD_SHA}' stayed literal, git fetch asked for a ref of that name, rc=128
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: placeholders @@LAEUFER:VAR@@ in the body plus a generated laeufer_einsetzen() that substitutes quoting-blind before execution

defects_found_and_repaired.cause: working-directory was translated neither per step nor from 'defaults: run:'.
defects_found_and_repaired.observed: frank-provider-fence-fresh-main-vps ran in the empty workspace, 'fatal: not a git repository' from step 2, rc=1 after 2.4 s, 0 of 20 PASS_ markers, red on 25 PRs
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: working-directory honoured per step and from defaults, as the 5th argument of the generated schritt(); absent it, $GITHUB_WORKSPACE

frank-provider-fence-fresh-main-vps.before: rc=1 after ~2.4 s, 0 of 20 PASS_ markers

claycode-frontier-integration-vps.after: PENDING — no post-fix run on disk at the time of writing

claycode-frontier-current-main-compositi.after: re-run started 2026-08-13T02:37:17Z, still executing when this record was written

external_effect_performed: commit statuses on Dr.-Unterweger pull requests only
epistemic_consequence: A red verdict from a second instrument is a gate verdict only if the instrument reached the gate's own assertion step. Executed step count and PASS_ marker count must be reported next to the exit code.
